name: Tractor Loan
summary: A tractor is an essential necessity of farming therefore ABHI brings Tractor Loan for all farmers.
intro: A tractor is an essential necessity of farming therefore ABHI brings Tractor Loan for farmers. It gives them the opportunity to buy a new or used tractors at low markup rates to help increase their agricultural yield.

sections.title: Features & Specifications
items: Credit Amount from PKR 500,000 to PKR 2,000,000
Available for the purchase of new or old tractor
Instant SMS alert on every transaction

sections.title: Min Eligibility Requirements
items: Age between 21 yrs to 65 yrs (at the time of loan approval)
Experience in crop farming for >1 year
Personal & Business address within the zone/radius of the associated branch

name: Niswan Karza
summary: A short to medium-term loan facility for female entrepreneurs.
intro: A successful woman is the one who can build a firm foundation. Niswan Karza helps women build that foundation with a loan for their business needs.

sections.title: Features & Specifications
items: Convenient & easy to understand paper work
Instant SMS alerts on every transaction
ABHI Bank App – Digital Mobile Application

sections.title: Min Eligibility Requirements
items: Hold Valid CNIC (Computerized National Identity Card).
Age between 21 to 62 Years (At the time of approval of loan).
Not Part of Any Customer / Loan Exclusion / Negative List.
Involved in Business for Last 01 Year.
Running Business at Current Location for Last 01 Year.

name: Karobari Karza
summary: A loan facility that helps businessmen raise capital for their businesses.
intro: Take your business to new heights with Karobari Karza that gives you a chance to fulfil your working capital / capital expenditure requirements for your business.

sections.title: Features & Specifications
items: Credit Amount ranges from PKR 100,000 to PKR 500,000
Credit tenure can be 6, 12, 15, 18 or 24 months
Convenient & easy to understand paper work
Instant SMS alerts on every transaction

sections.title: Min Eligibility Requirements
items: Age between 21 to 66 years (at the time of loan approval)

name: Kashtkar Karza
summary: A loan that meets a farmer’s financial needs to support expansion of their farming business.
intro: Kashtkar Karza gives farmers the opportunity to expand their farming business. Repayment of this loan is synced with crop cycles to provide ease.

sections.title: Features & Specifications
items: Credit amount from PKR 50,000 to PKR 500,000
Tenure from 3 to 12 months (15 months for Sugarcane only)
Convenient & easy to understand loan process
Instant SMS alerts on every transaction

sections.title: Min Eligibility Requirements
items: Age between 21 to 66 years (at the time of approval of loan)
Experience in crop farming for >1 year

name: Maweshi Karza
summary: A convenient lending product that caters to the needs of livestock farmers.
intro: A loan facility that is designed to meet the ever growing financial needs of the livestock sector to increase productivity and fulfill capital requirements.

sections.title: Features & Specifications
items: Credit amount ranges from PKR 100,000 to PKR 500,000
Repayment in Equal Monthly Installments or Lump Sum
Tenure from 3 to 12 (Lump Sum); 6, 12, 15, 18 or 24 months (EMI)
Convenient & easy to understand paper work
Instant SMS alerts on every transaction

sections.title: Min Eligibility Requirements

name: Sunheri Karza
summary: Convert your gold jewelry into working capital for your business needs.
intro: Instead of selling your gold to finance or expand your business, you can now provide gold as a security collateral against the loan while still keeping ownership of your gold.

sections.title: Features & Specifications
items: Credit Amount from PKR 100,000 to PKR 5,000,000
Credit tenure can be 6 to 12, 18, 24 & 36 months (EMI); 3 to 12 & 18 months (Lump Sum)
Repayment in Lump Sum or Equal Monthly Installments
Convenient & easy to understand paper work
Instant SMS alerts on every transaction

sections.title: Min Eligibility Requirements
items: Age between 18 to 70 years (at the time of loan approval)

name: House Loan (Renovation / Improvement)
summary: A medium to long-term loan facility for house renovation purposes.
intro: House Loan is a medium to long term loan facility. The product is designed for renovation, improvement, extension, restoration and enhancement of customer’s existing housing unit.

sections.title: Features & Specifications
items: Credit Amount from PKR 75,000 to PKR 2,000,000.
Credit Tenure: Up to 5 years (up to 24 months for unsecured).
Instant SMS alerts on every transaction.

sections.title: Min Eligibility Requirements
items: Age limit 21 to 62 years (up to 60 years for salaried individuals).
02 years business / employment experience (03 years for contractual employee).

name: Motorcycle Loan
summary: A short to medium-term conveyance loan facility designed to finance motorcycle (s) of reputed brand (s).
intro: Motorcycle Loan is funded secured short to medium-term loan facility classified as business / conveyance loan and is designed to finance motorcycle (s) of reputed brand (s). The loan is payable in equal monthly installments. This facility will be extended for Business transportation needs of businessperson/ self-employed professionals & carriage needs of Milkman (Livestock dairy customers).

sections.title: Features & Specifications

Convenient & easy to understand paper work.
Instant SMS alerts on every transactions.
